correctness.rationale: The reflection-orbit de Bruijn multigraph has degrees 3,5,2,5,2,3 and therefore no Euler trail, excluding the only otherwise possible lengths 22 and 23. Mirror-factor count excludes shorter lengths. Every length-24 palindrome corresponds bijectively to a 14-symbol prefix with palindromic last four bits and all ten orbit classes. An exhaustive ten-bit-mask dynamic program generates all 16384 prefixes once and yields exactly six complete palindromes. Independent direct enumeration over every palindrome length 4 through 24 reproduces the six examples and minimum. The proof is finite and no assertion for arbitrary order is made.

value.rationale: The count identifies all equality cases for the natural smallest-palindromic-superstring design problem at the first binary order with a non-Eulerian reversal quotient. Earlier results give an optimum length and an example, but not whether there are other optimal words or how they fall into complement classes. Exactly six indexed designs in three complement pairs answers that motivated classification fully without treating repeated order increments or trivial renamings as separate findings.
